title: The student of the logged actions over seeds, at the widths around its knee
description: Step 5 of the plan (docs/methodology.md). The student of release exp-student-search-16 (experiments/codec.py with targets=action: k latents between an encoder of one step's message and a decoder that also reads the controller's identity and predicts that controller's change of window over 60, 240 and 960 ms) with the settings chosen there on validation links: dropout 0.3 and learning rate 3e-4, width 512, encoder depth 4, decoder width 512, weight decay 1e-4, 10 epochs, fixed widths. Seeds 0 to 4 at 2, 3, 4, 6 and 8 latents and at 64 latents (the model with no narrow layer), 30 cells. On one seed the rule of docs/methodology.md (the smallest width within 5% of the skill at 64 latents) gave 3 latents while the curve kept rising to 8; these seeds say how much of that is noise. The score is R^2 on the validation links over all anchors, each controller's changes scaled to unit variance; skill is against predicting that the window does not change. It is offline: predicting logged actions from one step is not control. Steps: release exp-steps-broad-30s-9. The test links are not read. The trained weights are kept.
run: K=${JOB%-s*}; K=${K#k}; SEED=${JOB##*-s}; uv run python experiments/codec.py train "$OUT/runs/$JOB" --data "$IN/steps" --set targets=action --set 'horizons=[1,4,16]' --set nested=false --set k=$K --set dropout=0.3 --set lr=0.0003 --set seed=$SEED --set width=512 --set depth=4 --set dec_width=512 --set weight_decay=0.0001 --set epochs=10 --set time_budget_s=18000
